To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
audit quality is a multidimensional construct, which includes the dimensions of audit planning, evidence accumulation and evaluation, and reporting.
Audit process quality is a function of the quality of the evidence obtained, the completeness of the evidence obtained and the timeliness of the evidence obtained.
Audit process quality can be evaluated using 11 objective measures of audit process quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of audit process factors that affect the quality of audit engagements, with the development of a framework for measuring the quality of the process used to conduct an audit engagement and with the development of the means for evaluating the audit process for an engagement.
developing a more objective and more comprehensive audit quality measure.
identifying and measuring those aspects of the audit process that are most likely to have an effect on the quality of the audit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the framework developed for evaluating audit process performance provides a more objective and more comprehensive measure of the quality of the audit than any measure previously available.
audit quality is a function of a number of process quality factors that are weighted by a number of factors that reflect the relative importance of each process quality factor.
this framework is a significant step toward the development of objective audit process quality measures that can be used to improve audit quality and enhance the credibility of the audit profession.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of an audit process depends on the quality of the audit team, the audit plan, the evidence obtained, the analysis and evaluation of the evidence, and the audit report.
the audit process is more complex than previously recognized and that audit quality is a multidimensional construct.
the audit process quality framework is a valuable tool in assessing audit quality and that audit quality can be measured in terms of deviations from a standard audit process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
audit quality can be assessed by measuring deviations from the audit processes that are generally considered to be best practices.
audit process quality is a multi-dimensional concept that can be objectively measured.
the audit quality literature is dominated by research that is based on the opinions of end users and/or auditors.
